purpose: Show current ERP status names for purchase requests, purchase orders and inbound requests using source-backed fixed dictionary bindings.
constraints: Root alone publishes after independent source/privacy review and exact head/base CI. No private customer rows, raw SQL/archive, credentials or screenshots in public repository.

Preserve raw numeric statusId. Live fixed typed LEFT JOINs only, one grouped dictionary row per ID to avoid pagination multiplication; duplicate, missing, null, blank or invalid labels use explicit unknown fallback, never guessed workflow meaning. No arbitrary stored config SQL or per-row network lookup.
Status labels are read-only metadata, not additions to aggregate command DTOs, canonical intent, receipts, token hashing, workflow transitions or editability. No new status filter in this slice.
New apps/medcom-sites helper/contracts are owned here; rendering owned by I36. Legacy src/frontend/lib/contracts.ts may gain optional nullable statusName for strict parser compatibility only.

SqlPurchaseRequestQueries and query tests overlap I37 only in independent status projection/fixture hunks. Root must compose by exact hunks and rerun combined tests; never overwrite the other candidate.

No actual SQL, private config or native DLL execution, schema/settings changes or runtime/write activation. Source labels are technical metadata backed by verified archive/member identity and line references.
